B_DISPOSABLE_POSTGRES_PROOF.why_constant_sentinels: The first draft generated its control value with randomBytes; the repository-hosted live-mint detector flagged the script (marker + generator + driver). The detector was NOT changed: the script was changed so that it genuinely generates no secret. The only generated value is the pinned outside tool's.
B_DISPOSABLE_POSTGRES_PROOF.measured_on_first_run: A blocker that ALTERed the same pg_authid row made the tool's own ALTER fail with XX000 (tuple concurrently updated), masked by the DO block as D1_CREDENTIAL_SET_FAILED; the tool classified it DEFINITELY_NOT_COMMITTED and deposited nothing. The blocker was changed to a SHARE lock on pg_authid, which produces the lock wait without touching the row.

F_PEB_OBSERVER.not_claimed: No Windows guarantee is claimed: the observer polls, so a process living less than one poll is never seen and a protected process is recorded unreadable. F_PEB_OBSERVER.n05_consumers: The N05 / production-topology demonstrations aggregate by sets of pids; with identity-keyed records a reused pid now yields two records, which those set-based checks include conservatively (over-inclusion, fail-closed). Their logic is not changed by this lane.

G_TLS: OPEN OWNER BOUNDARY, recorded in the channel authority amendment v1.0.1 TLS_TRUST_BOUNDARY and not decided here. Additional interplay measured by this lane: the verifier (derived material) reaches server logs wherever an emitter quotes the ALTER ROLE; its ServerKey lets a holder impersonate the server in a SCRAM exchange, and its StoredKey plus one observed exchange yields ClientKey. With no server authentication (ssl 'require') and no channel binding, the confidentiality of the auditor's future sessions against an on-path actor who can also read those logs depends on the root-of-trust decision. The plaintext fix itself does not depend on TLS.
